This narrows origin to prior model evolution/state, but does not rule out later UDM amplification. Halo/stale copies are separate in capture-on-v2/halo-target-only-summary-v2.json and are not included in this owner comparison.

source.details: adjust_number_concent branches when nn<=nnmin=1.e-3 m-3. For qq>qqmin it sets lamdar=drconst/di0 and recomputes nn; otherwise it computes lamdar from supplied nn, clips diameter against [dimin,dimax], recomputes nn, and applies nnmax. If qq<=qqmin, both qq and nn become zero.
